# Bundled Apollo model code

This directory contains the Apollo model implementation, copied **unmodified**
from [JusperLee/Apollo](https://github.com/JusperLee/Apollo) at commit
`e84bcac` (2026-08-24).

- Upstream license: **CC BY-SA 4.0** — see `LICENSE` in this directory.
- Weights: `JusperLee/Apollo` → `pytorch_model.bin`, downloaded at first run.
  The weights are also CC BY-SA 4.0.
- Changes: none. Files were copied verbatim from `look2hear/models/`
  (`apollo.py`, `base_model.py`, `__init__.py`).

Airlift Audio's own source is MIT licensed; this directory is an aggregate
third-party component and remains under its original license. Attribution:
Kai Li and Yi Luo, "Apollo: Band-sequence Modeling for High-Quality Audio
Restoration" (ICASSP 2025), Tsinghua University / Tencent AI Lab.
